title: 15.68. Niyataduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Niyataṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Aniyataṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.

Niyataṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Aniyataṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyato naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve. (Abyākatamūle dve paccayavasena.)
